description:
The trails associated with Skimikin Recreation site are multi purpose catering to ATV use and horse use.

The trails are jointly maintained by the Backcountry Horsemen of BC and the Shuswap Backcountry Riders.

There is a care taker on site collecting camping fees from April 1 to October 31.
directions: Exit Hwy 1 at Tappen Valley Road, drive 3.8 km, turn left on Skimikin Road for 5.8 km. All paved roads.
title: Skimikin Trail Network
